Fire risk assessment, evidenced.

Safentia is software for fire risk assessment, with templates for PAS 79-1:2020 and BS 9792, or built to your own methodology. Assessors capture evidence on site, auditors validate it question by question, and the Responsible Person receives a report they can act on.

Native iOS and Android app for the field, a web console for the office.

From the field to a released report

Capture offline

Templated questions, titled photo evidence and floor-plan flags on a native app. Basements, plant rooms, no signal: work is stored on the device and syncs automatically. Nothing is lost.

Validate with named stages

Every assessment moves through a fixed lifecycle, from Assessment in progress to Released. Auditors flag specific questions and assessors respond, so nothing goes out unchecked.

Release a branded report

On release, a formal PDF is generated server-side: risk profile, transparent question tables, a severity-ordered action plan and your organisation's own branding.

A closer look

Built for basements and blackspots

The field app supports the PAS 79 structure and BS 9792 for housing. Assessors answer templated questions, attach titled photo evidence and pin location flags on floor plans, all fully offline with automatic sync.

Each non-conformity carries a severity of Low, Medium or High, a responsible party, a due date and a Life Protection flag where life safety is at stake. The detail is captured once, on site, not reconstructed later at a desk.

Riser cupboard, level 2

Obstructed escape route

Validation that leaves a trail

Every assessment moves through five named stages. An auditor reviews the finished work and, where something needs more, flags the specific questions rather than bouncing the whole job back. The assessor responds to each flag, and the exchange is kept.

  1. 1Assessment in progress
  2. 2Ready for validation
  3. 3More information required
  4. 4Complete, ready for release
  5. 5Released

A report the Responsible Person can act on

On release, the platform generates a formal PDF server-side: an overview, a proportionally accurate Green, Amber and Red risk profile, and every section laid out as a transparent question table. No black box between the assessment and the document.

The action plan is ordered by severity, with titled images and floor-plan locations against each item, under your organisation's own branding and a Conducted by, Checked by and Validated by sign-off.

Built for the whole organisation

Safentia is multi-tenant with full data isolation, and every account holds one or more of five staff roles. Customers can be invited in with their own scoped access. The web console handles setup, validation, reporting and your own assessment templates, customised from the provided defaults or built from scratch, while buildings carry their own service schedules and an append-only log book.

  • Admin

    Sets up buildings, templates, people and permissions.

  • Assessor

    Works through templated questions on site, connected or not.

  • Auditor

    Reviews finished assessments and flags specific questions.

  • Finance

    Holds commercial access without touching assessment data.

  • Viewer

    Read-only access across buildings, scores and reports.

  • Customer

    Invited to view their own buildings, scores and released reports.
